children: Insider trades were seen across heavyweights, including Netflix
, Intel
, and Visa
, this week. The following transactions occurred between November 2 and November 6.
Netflix

saw several insiders execute transactions this week. Co-CEO Theodore Sarandos sold 27,312 shares at $66.20 each for around $1.81M. The sale accounted for about 13.24% of his direct holdings, leaving him with 178,954 shares. CFO Spencer Neumann sold shares worth $612,109, while chief legal officer David Hyman let go of shares worth $369,678.
GE
Vice President Robert Giglietti sold 14,796 shares at about $332 each for about $4.92M. The transaction represented about 42.28% of his direct holdings, leaving him with 20,201 shares.
Chevron’s
President of New Energies Jeff Gustavson sold 24,439 shares at $230.71 each for $5.64M. The transaction represented about 86.48% of his holdings, leaving him with 3,821 shares.
Visa
President of Technology Rajat Taneja sold 34,417 shares at $426.79 each for $14.69M. The sale accounted for about 12.91% of his direct holdings, leaving him with 232,112 shares.
Procter & Gamble
Chief Financial Officer Andre Schulten sold 33,624 shares at $165 each for $5.55M. The transaction represented about 31.47% of his holdings, leaving him with 73,222 shares.
Intel
CEO Lip-Bu Tan purchased 150,000 shares at $64.73 each for $9.71M, increasing his holdings to 1,481,640 shares.
Boeing

director Mortimer Buckley acquired 5,820 shares at $171.55 each for $998,421, bringing his total holdings to 10,250 shares. Meanwhile, Steven Mollenkopf purchased 2,950 shares at $173.03 each for $510,427, increasing his holdings to 6,717 shares.
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing
Vice President Lipen Yuan purchased 1,000 shares at $71.49 each for $71,490, bringing his total holdings to 11,341 shares.
Caterpillar
director James Fish Jr. purchased 1,000 shares at $620.39 each for $620,390, increasing his holdings to 5,214 shares.
BlackBerry
director David Chaikof purchased 5,000 shares at $8.18 each for $40,900, bringing his total holdings to 5,000 shares.
